title: Fourth Layer of Tianji
next_chapter_hook: In the instant when his other self in the fate lines met his gaze, Chen Ji heard a voice from the future—"You've finally arrived."

text.content: The words on the letter trembled beneath Chen Ji's fingertips, the phrase "Your father still lives to this day" striking like thunder, cracking the mask of composure he'd maintained for years. He drew a sharp breath, tucked the letter into his sleeve, and swept his gaze across the swirling spirit mist at the secret realm's entrance. Ye Qing beside him sensed his anomaly but asked nothing, merely extending the black纱 in her hand. "Need it?" Her voice was soft. Chen Ji took the black纱, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his mouth: "No need. There aren't many in this world who can see through me anyway."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's brow furrowed slightly, her eyes beneath the black纱 flickering with complex light: "Your reaction just now... wasn't like you." Chen Ji offered no answer, merely walking slowly toward the barrier at the secret realm's entrance. Spirit mist coiled around him, icy cold, yet couldn't penetrate three feet of his personal space. The Tianji Record fragment in his Mental Sea quivered faintly, as if sensing something. He stopped, raised his head to gaze at the layered fate threads, and his pupils constricted sharply—there, within the barrier, an unprecedented fate line was slowly taking shape.

text.content: "Right here." Chen Ji's voice was low and certain. He sat cross-legged on the blue stone before the barrier, formed seals with both hands, and the Tianji Record fragment slowly manifested from his Brow Center. Mo Xiansheng's voice arose in his Mental Sea, carrying rare solemnity: "Are you certain you want to break through here? At the confluence of fate lines, one misstep means annihilation." A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips: "Sir, I've waited for this moment far too long." Before the words even finished, the runes on the fragment began flickering madly, streams of golden light pouring from the fragment into his Brow Center. Agonizing pain struck, Chen Ji clenched his teeth, veins bulging on his forehead, yet he refused to let out a single groan.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing watched that figure enveloped in golden light, a barely perceptible ache flickering in her eyes beneath the black纱. She knew what this man was enduring—every breakthrough was dancing on a blade's edge. She quietly activated the Demonic Path Mists, shrouding all breath within a hundred zhang. In the distance, several concealed divine senses swept past, only to be deflected entirely by the mist. "Focus." Her voice was soft, yet it rang clearly in Chen Ji's ears: "The outside matters, leave them to me." Chen Ji didn't open his eyes, yet a faint smile curved his lips. The pain of breakthrough seemed to ease slightly.

text.content: The golden light grew increasingly intense, and a brilliant sea of stars suddenly exploded within Chen Ji's Mental Sea. Countless points of light floated like fireflies, each one a node on a fate line. The mysteries of the Fifth Layer of the Tianji Record flooded his consciousness—Foresight of Fate Lines! He could see every person's behavioral trajectory within the next three shichen, could see the causal networks formed by the interweaving of these trajectories, and more crucially, he could see those hidden turning points of destiny. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying rare excitement: "Fifth Layer, complete!" Chen Ji forcefully opened his eyes, golden runes swirling in his pupils, as if capable of seeing through all illusions in the world.

dialogue.content: "I see it." Chen Ji's voice carried traces of trembling: "I saw the death prophecy spanning 700 chapters... it's changing." Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, then slowly said: "Correct. Because of your appearance, the formerly certain death timeline has already forked. But this is also the most dangerous moment—Heaven's Mandate won't sit idly by while its arrangements are altered." Before the words finished, an inexplicable chill suddenly descended upon Chen Ji's crown, a strange coldness spreading upward from his tailbone. The Tianji Record fragment trembled violently, as if warning him of something. He saw it! At the confluence of destiny, a blurry figure was slowly taking shape—that was no other than himself.

text.content: "This is impossible!" Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently. He could make out that figure's features were identical to his own, yet it wore a black Daoist robe he'd never seen before, heavy death energy coiling around it. That was... his future self? The other "Chen Ji" raised its head, as if gazing across the river of time to meet his eyes, a strange smile curving its lips. It opened its mouth to speak, yet no sound emerged. However, Chen Ji understood the lip shape perfectly—"You and I share the same origin." Mo Xiansheng's voicesuddenlynervous起来："That is destiny's counterflow materialization! If you cannot subdue it, the Fifth Layer's power of the Tianji Record will be devoured by it!"

choice.prompt: Faced with the materialized counterflow of destiny—the "other self"—Chen Ji had to make a choice.

choices.text: Take the initiative to attack and devour the destiny counterflow
choices.description: Forcefully suppress the destiny counterflow using the Fifth Layer's power of the Tianji Record, turning it into one's own use. If successful, unprecedented control over destiny will be gained; if failed, the Mental Sea will be eroded by the counterflow, with dire consequences.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the passive skill "Destiny Devouring," increase fate line control by 200%
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk—failure will lead to Mental Sea collapse, becoming a walking corpse

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes blazed with brilliant light. He opened his mouth to inhale, the Tianji Record fragment transforming into a golden stream of light that wrapped around him as he charged toward that black figure. The star sea in his Mental Sea violently convulsed, countless points of light drawn by this force, forming a brilliant galaxy. The black figure didn't dodge or evade, charging forward as well—the two forces collided violently in midair!

Agonizing pain nearly tore his consciousness apart, but Chen Ji gritted his teeth, both hands gripping the black figure's throat. "I am Chen Ji!" His voice echoed through the Mental Sea: "My destiny, I myself shall write!" Golden light began eroding the black death energy, bit by bit, like flames burning腐朽的木头。 The black figure let out a soundless howl, struggling but unable to break free. Ultimately, it transformed into wisp of black smoke, swallowed by Chen Ji in one gulp.

choices.text: Retreat to advance, coexist with the counterflow
choices.description: Not forcibly devouring, but using the mysteries of the Tianji Record to seal the destiny counterflow deep within the Mental Sea, transforming enemy into ally. Lower risk, but may be unable to fully control the Fifth Layer's power, facing greater hidden dangers during future breakthroughs.
choices.visible_reward: The Fifth Layer of the Tianji Record stabilizes and unlocks, adding a lifesaving trump card within the Mental Sea
choices.risk_hint: Medium risk—unstable seals may suffer sneak attacks from the counterflow

text.content: Chen Ji didn't choose to clash head-on. Instead, he slowly raised his right hand, the Tianji Record fragment transforming into a complex rune in his palm. "Use heaven as the furnace, life as the guide, seal!" The rune shot forth, weaving a golden net around that black figure. The black figure struggled wildly but couldn't break free from the net's binding. Its howls transformed into soundless screams, ultimately compressed into a particle of black light, suspended deep within Chen Ji's Mental Sea.

"For now, this will do." Chen Ji said softly, a complex light flickering in his eyes. Though he hadn't fully devoured it, he could feel the Fifth Layer's abilities steadily awakening—the range of fate line foresight had expanded to twelve shichen, and he could now see more hidden destiny nodes. Mo Xiansheng sighed: "This is a steady choice, but the hidden danger hasn't been eliminated. Someday in the future, it will break free from the seal." A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips: "Then we'll wait for that day. At least now, I have time."

Golden light gradually收敛, Chen Ji slowly stood up, his aura entirely different from before. The mysteries of the Fifth Layer of the Tianji Record had fully integrated into his Mental Sea. He could clearly sense his vision had been infinitely broadened—the range that originally only showed things within three shichen had expanded to an astonishing twelve shichen, and the clarity of the images had greatly improved. Ye Qing收起the Demonic Path Mists, walking to his side, her eyes beneath the black纱 carrying a hint of scrutiny: "Succeeded?" Chen Ji nodded, a faint smile curving his lips: "Barely, one might say." He raised his hand, a point of golden light condensing at his fingertip. With a casual wave—that point of golden light transformed into an illusory eye, suspended in midair, reflecting all movements within a ten-li radius.

dialogue.content: "Is this the power of the fifth level?" Ye Qing's voice carried a hint of curiosity. Chen Ji nodded, withdrawing that illusory eye: "Foresight of fate lines. The range I can see is further, and the clarity is higher. Moreover..." He paused, a complex light flickering in his eyes, "I saw the death prophecy of chapter 700 is changing. That timeline originally pointing toward death now has a fork." Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, then softly said: "That's good." Chen Ji turned to look at her, a playful curve forming at the corner of his mouth: "Ye Saint seems very concerned about me?" Ye Qing snorted coldly, turning her head away: "I just don't want my partner to die too early." Chen Ji laughed lightly: "Rest assured, I still owe you a truth. Before that, I won't die."

text.content: Just then, a violent fluctuation came from the entrance of the secret realm. The heavy stone door slowly opened, an ancient and desolate aura rushing toward them. Chen Ji and Ye Qing turned simultaneously, their gazes falling on the slowly opening stone door. Behind it lay a chaotic void, countless light particles floating in the emptiness like an inverted river of stars. Chen Ji frowned slightly, the fifth-level ability of the Tianji Record automatically operating—he saw it! Hidden within this chaotic void was an extremely concealed fate line, its endpoint pointing in a direction he never expected. "Interesting." he murmured softly, a meaningful smile curling his lips, "It seems within this secret realm, there are other 'spectators' waiting for me."

choice.prompt: The secret realm entrance has opened, and Chen Ji needs to decide how to explore.

choices.description: Taking advantage of the fact the other party hasn't reacted yet, directly enter the secret realm to assess the situation. If the other party is an enemy, strike first; if a friend, seize the initiative. Higher risk, but may yield unexpected gains.
choices.visible_reward: Grasp the initiative, gain strategic advantage within the secret realm
choices.risk_hint: Risk unknown—the other party's strength is unclear

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate in the slightest, striding into the secret realm entrance. Ye Qing followed closely behind, demonic path mist swirling around her, concealing both their auras. The stone door slowly closed behind them, cutting off all sounds from the outside world. "Your courage is quite bold." Ye Qing's voice rang out in the darkness. Chen Ji smiled lightly: "How else does one survive in this chaotic world?" His gaze swept across the floating light particles around him, a faint smile forming at his lips: "Besides, I've already seen it."

The moment his voice fell, those floating light particles suddenly converged and took shape, forming a massive vertical pupil. The vertical pupil was crimson as blood, its cold gaze falling upon Chen Ji as if examining an insignificant ant. Yet Chen Ji showed no fear whatsoever, instead raising his head to meet that vertical pupil's stare. "How long have you been hiding here?" His voice was calm, "Did you come specifically to wait for me, or... merely passing by?" The vertical pupil gave no answer, merely blinking slowly. An invisible pressure suddenly descended, Chen Ji's knees bent slightly, yet he refused to kneel.

choices.description: Without rushing in recklessly, first use the Tianji Record's ability to probe the direction of fate lines within the secret realm, ascertain the other party's details before making a decision. More stable, but may miss the opportunity for initiative, allowing the other party to prepare.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 15 Heavenly Fate points for deep investigation
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete intelligence, formulate optimal strategy
choices.risk_hint: Low risk—but may expose the probing behavior

text.content: Chen Ji didn't rush into the secret realm, instead closing his eyes. The Tianji Record Fragment slowly rotated within his Mental Sea. The fifth-level ability operated at full capacity; countless fate lines manifested before his eyes like an intertwined spider web. He followed that concealed fate line for deeper investigation, gradually seeing the other party's outline—a blurry figure, surrounded by an aura entirely different from the Heavenly Way, desolate and ancient, as if from time immemorial.

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, a flash of astonishment passing through his pupils: "This is impossible... that's an ancient aura." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out in his Mental Sea, carrying a hint of gravity: "What did you see?" Chen Ji said deeply: "A figure. Or rather, an existence that has been sleeping for God knows how many years. It's waiting for me—or rather, waiting for the wielder of the Tianji Record." A meaningful smile formed at the corner of his lips, "It seems the secrets behind this secret realm are far greater than I imagined."

That crimson vertical pupil slowly blinked, an invisible will surging toward Chen Ji like a tide. Chen Ji felt his mind explode with a roar, countless scenes flashing before him like a carousel—he saw the moment the Tianji Record was first created, witnessed the falls of generations of prophets, and saw an even more terrifying image: a giant eye covering the entire heavens, coldly overlooking this great land. "Heavenly Way's Eye..." Chen Ji murmured, a complex light flickering in his eyes. That vertical pupil seemed to sense something, its crimson pupil suddenly contracting, an even more terrifying might pouring down.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" Ye Qing's voice carried urgency, she stood before Chen Ji, her black veil fluttering violently in that oppressive might, "That thing is not right!" Yet Chen Ji didn't retreat, instead stepping forward, directly facing that crimson vertical pupil. His voice was calm yet resolute: "You've waited so long, surely you didn't just come to give me a show of force?" The vertical pupil fell silent for a moment, then suddenly let out a low laugh. That laughter was ancient and hoarse, like rock grinding: "Tianji Record's inheritor... truly interesting. This one has waited for you a long time." Before the words finished, the vertical pupil scattered into countless light particles, replaced by an aged figure, suspended within the chaotic void.

text.content: That aged figure's face was indistinct, its body wrapped in an aura entirely different from the Heavenly Way—not demonic energy, not spiritual energy, but a more ancient, more primordial force. Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly, the fifth-level ability of the Tianji Record automatically operating—he saw it! On that figure, the fate lines presented a bizarre intertwined state, as if forcibly stitched together by something. "Who are you?" Chen Ji asked deeply. That aged figure let out a soft laugh: "Who I am doesn't matter. What matters is... I have a deal to discuss with you." He raised his hand, pointing at Chen Ji, "A deal concerning the Heavenly Way's Eye."

choice.prompt: A mysterious existence has proposed a deal, and Chen Ji needs to make a decision.

choices.text: Hear what he has to say
choices.description: First hear the contents of this deal, after all, the other party knows of the Heavenly Way's Eye's existence and may provide valuable intelligence. But remain vigilant, don't easily promise any price.
choices.visible_cost: May fall into unknown karmic debt
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence regarding the Heavenly Way's Eye
choices.risk_hint: Medium risk - the other party's intentions are unclear

text.content: Chen Ji did not rush to respond, instead slightly nodding: 'Please, speak.' The withered elderly figure let out a meaningful laugh: 'Indeed someone who could survive until now, cautious enough.' He slowly paced, his voice echoing through the void: 'The Eye of Heavenly Way is neither a person nor a faction—it is a will. A will that surpasses the Heavenly Way itself. It treats all prophecy-seers throughout history as chess pieces, and the Tianji Record is merely one of the many pieces it has placed.'

Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted, his heart skipping a beat. Mo Xiansheng was also silent within the Mental Sea, clearly this news was new to him as well. Chen Ji said deeply: 'Why are you telling me all this?' The withered elderly figure turned around, for the first time directly facing Chen Ji: 'Because I hate it. Ten thousand years ago, it trapped me here, weaving fate with my bloodline. And you...' He extended a withered finger, pointing at Chen Ji, 'You are the only person who might break this chess game.'

choices.description: The other party's origins are unclear, hasty contact may lead to falling into a trap. Better to maintain distance and wait until more intelligence is gathered before deciding. Better to miss an opportunity than to easily take risks.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independence, not owe any karma
choices.risk_hint: Low risk - but may lose the chance to obtain the truth

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, a faint, indifferent smile curling at his lips: 'I appreciate the Elder's kindness, but I have a principle - opportunities with unclear origins, I never touch.' The withered elderly figure did not seem surprised, instead letting out a low chuckle: 'Interesting. Even more cautious than I anticipated.' He waved his hand, and a portal suddenly appeared in the void, 'Then forget it. This is the exit, you may leave whenever you wish.'

Chen Ji did not immediately step through the portal, instead turning to look at Ye Qing: 'What do you think?' Ye Qing was silent for a moment before softly speaking: 'What he said carries some credibility. But his purpose cannot be that simple.' Chen Ji nodded, his gaze returning to the withered figure: 'Elder, will this door remain open?' The withered figure seemed amused: 'As you wish. If you reconsider, you can return anytime. But remember—opportunity comes only once.' Chen Ji slightly nodded, taking Ye Qing's hand and turning to leave. Yet in the instant before stepping into the portal, a subtle, knowing smile curved his lips.

Passing through the portal, Chen Ji and Ye Qing stood once again at the entrance of the secret realm. Ye Qing retracted her Demonic Path mist, turning to look at Chen Ji: 'Do you believe what he said?' Chen Ji did not answer directly, instead raising his head to gaze at the horizon, where the clouds churned as if something was watching them. He said softly: 'Belief is irrelevant. What matters is that what he said matches what I saw using the Tianji Record.' He paused, a complex gleam flickering in his eyes: 'The Eye of Heavenly Way... it seems my opponents are far more formidable than I imagined.' Ye Qing remained silent for a moment, then suddenly asked: 'Are you afraid?' Chen Ji turned to look at her, a wild grin spreading across his face: 'Afraid? Quite the opposite. Right now... I'm even more excited.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing gazed at the light in Chen Ji's eyes, her heart unexpectedly racing. This man... was truly dangerous. Not dangerous to her, but to the entire world. She suddenly recalled a statement Chen Ji had made when they first began cooperating - 'The chess game I play, I have never lost.' She spoke softly: 'What now?' Chen Ji did not answer, instead slowly closing his eyes. The Tianji Record's fifth layer ability activated once more, and this time, he saw more—within the layers of fate lines, he spotted a familiar figure standing before the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, waiting for him. 'Su Qingyao...' he murmured, 'You're always the most perceptive.' He opened his eyes, a faint smile playing on his lips, 'Let's go. It's time to return.'

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was preparing to leave, his steps suddenly halted. The Tianji Record Fragment violently trembled within his Mental Sea, a strong premonition surging through his heart. He abruptly turned back, gazing into the depths of the secret realm—among those floating specks of light, he saw another strand of fate slowly taking shape. That strand's end pointed to a figure he was extremely familiar with. 'Chen Nian?' His pupils sharply contracted, his sister's name escaping his lips. That strand of fate was blurry and twisted, as if deliberately concealed by something, but the information it contained made Chen Ji's heart suddenly race—Chen Nian was alive, and she was right here in the secret realm!

Chen Ji's fingers slightly trembled—this was the first time he had lost composure in all these years. Ye Qing noticed his abnormality, frowning and asking: 'What's wrong?' Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the excitement in his heart: 'Nothing.' His voice regained its composure, but his gaze became sharper than ever before, 'I just discovered an... unexpected surprise.' He once more gazed into the depths of the secret realm, the Tianji Record's fifth layer ability operating at full capacity, attempting to see more details of that strand of fate. However, every time he tried to probe deeper, his vision would become blurred, as if an invisible force was obstructing him. 'Interesting.' He said softly, a meaningful smile curving his lips, 'It seems some people... don't want me to find her that quickly.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing was silent for a moment, then suddenly spoke: 'I heard about your sister's situation.' Chen Ji turned to look at her, no surprise in his eyes: 'The intelligence network of the Holy Sect is indeed formidable.' Ye Qing shook her head: 'The Holy Sect took many people, Chen Nian was just one of them. But her identity... is more special than we imagined.' She paused, her voice dropping several notes, 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key—this is the code name the Holy Sect gave her. It is said her existence can interfere with all prophetic abilities.' Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted, the stone that had been weighing on his heart all this time finally settled. So that's it... no wonder he couldn't find any trace of Chen Nian no matter how hard he tried. It wasn't that he wasn't working hard enough, but that his sister's existence itself was interfering with the Tianji Record's probing.

text.content: Heavenly Fate Lock Key...' Chen Ji murmured, a complex gleam flickering in his eyes. He suddenly recalled the sentence from his father's letter—'Your father is still alive.' And that mysterious withered figure... everything seemed to be pointing toward a direction he had never considered. He raised his head, gazing into the depths of the secret realm, the Tianji Record Fragment slowly rotating within his Mental Sea. The fifth layer's ability allowed him to see more possibilities. He knew that this time he had to make a choice. Should he continue laying out his strategy for the world, or rescue his sister first? 'No.' He suddenly let out a light laugh, a playful gleam flickering in his eyes, 'Why can't I accomplish both?' He turned to look at Ye Qing, a confident smile curving his lips, 'Help me with a favor.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing gazed at the light in Chen Ji's eyes, an inexplicable feeling suddenly surging in her heart—this man, he was about to scheme something again. She said softly: 'What favor?' Chen Ji did not answer directly, instead taking a Jade Slip from his sleeve and handing it to her: 'Help me deliver this Jade Slip to the Tianqing Sect, to Su Qingyao. Tell her—the chess game is about to change, she should prepare.' Ye Qing took the Jade Slip, but did not immediately leave, instead looking at Chen Ji: 'What about you?' Chen Ji turned, gazing into the depths of the secret realm, an unprecedented gleam flickering in his eyes: 'I'm going in, to meet the existence that has been 'waiting' for me for a long time.' His voice was calm, yet carried an unshakable determination, 'And顺便... take my sister back.'
